# Constitution v7 · format 1 · 2026-09-14 · 9 rules
<!-- Generated. Edits here are overwritten. Use /coldwriter:prefer or /coldwriter:learn. -->

## Rules
- Keep the note under 300 characters.
- No em dashes.
- Use their first name only; never their title.
- One question, at the end, answerable in two minutes.
- One specific detail about them that isn't in their headline.
- No adjectives about their work ("impressive", "amazing").
- Never "I'd love to connect", "came across your profile", "pick your brain", "hope this finds you well".
- Never open with the recipient's job title.

## When the recipient is a founder
- Ask about a decision they made, not a topic.

## Examples
> Hi Ada, your post on Loomly's pricing reset stood out. I'm at Cornell studying how early teams price. How did you pick the moment to change it?
> Hey Chris, your post on killing the internal ticket queue hit home. I spent this summer at Acme building the tool that replaced ours. I'm at Cornell looking at Google PM roles and would love 15 min on how you decide what internal tooling deserves a real PM.
